decisions.reason: The FAQ already states that no-referral commissions and tickets go to a random existing NFT holder; this source does not require a copy change.
The source confirms no-referral behavior and does not change ticket issuance for mints that use a valid referral code.
The code-used commission behavior remains unchanged and is explicitly described as accurately reflected.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records that each no-referral mint issues one ticket.

The source requires exactly one $5 commission to be accounted for per completed primary mint, including no-code mints, and requires missing randomly assigned commissions to be reflected across accounting surfaces.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
At this point, we have completed 12 mints, so that should amount to 12 tickets & 12 x $5 commissions.

**Even if no referral code is used, a ticket and commission are still issued**.

Currently, **when a code is used**, it is accurately reflected on the leaderboards/NFT attributes. Perfect.

If **no referral code is used**, the ticket and commission are assigned at random.
(B**ut they must still be reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes**.)

I believe that since your most recent fix, the randomly assigned tickets from the last 2 mints have been reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes. Great.
However, the missing tickets have not been backfilled.

The commissions from these purchases without a code are also still not reflected on the leaderboard/NFT attributes.

In my screenshot, you will see that I have an NFT showing 2 tickets but only 1 x $5 commission. That should not be possible because each ticket includes a $5 commission.

Also, in my leaderboard screenshot, only 7 tickets and 5 x $5 commissions are accounted for out of 12 total mints.
Whether or not a referral code is used, 12 mints should result in 12 tickets and 12 x $5 commissions.

value_updates.commission_count_basis: Exactly one $5 commission must be accounted for per completed primary mint, whether or not a referral code is used; secondary-market sales are excluded.
value_updates.no_code_commission_projection: Randomly assigned $5 commissions from no-referral mints must be reflected on the dashboard, leaderboard, and in NFT attributes.

decisions.reason: The source changes commission issuance and accounting expectations, not the $15 price, $5 commission amount, founder share, or prize-pool allocation.
The existing same-message MODIFY already requires code-used and randomly allocated no-referral tickets and commissions to appear in NFT attributes.
The source explains operational commission accounting and does not request or necessitate a change to the landing-page mechanics copy.
Commission issuance without a code does not change how an NFT's permanent referral code is derived, displayed, shared, or transferred on resale.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records cross-surface ticket consistency and the required historical ticket backfill.
The About-page process copy already states that a no-code mint assigns the $5 commission and ticket to a random existing holder.
The validation rule and no-or-invalid-code feedback already specify random allocation of a $5 commission and ticket; code validity semantics remain unchanged.
